statement: The admitted reference application has a declared, executed operating envelope in which foreground and control work make useful progress, pressure preserves acknowledged obligations, retained resources are reclaimed under existing contracts, and restart/replay and cleanup costs are measured within the declared supported limits.

constraints.statement: Unsealed candidate from integration b85ba795076b9457b68b83698bc74898b4724cc9, runtime a3dcbe8c742a0b25551fdb145a6b5a877d0a3aa9, within solve/epics/operation-integrity-and-reliable-formation/reliable-application-operations-candidate.md. Reconcile the actual current source, original evidence and incumbent assignment before choosing a new write. This record creates no runtime reproduction, test execution, seal, competing writer or acceptance. Existing authority and authorized work continue.

Existing runtime/work-class, query/partition, cancellation, storage/CDC/TX and stabilization resource owners retain their boundaries. Scope is one declared application workload/topology/duration and its required resource/progress qualification. Route a demonstrated product defect to its bounded owner; do not authorize a repository-wide scheduling/threading refactor or a new monitoring framework.

Initial completion: 0.5 operating-envelope qualification under alpha packages 4/9 and existing stabilization Q08-Q11. Consume coordinator-sqlite-merge, current retained-read-view-generation-custody, ES6 safety and existing execution/retention contracts. Known violations of already admitted correctness remain current 0.4.1 corrections and cannot be deferred under this qualification label.

Before execution, freeze the existing owning profile's hardware, topology, dataset, offered/concurrent work, result limits, subscriptions/background-operation counts, duration, interruption schedule, acceptance bounds and independent oracles. Run that actual finite workload with modest foreground work, slow-replica/backpressure, cancellation and finite-blocker removal. Missing evidence or an unrun profile is unavailable, not a manufactured red; use the existing qualification owner to establish a genuine baseline or retain a verified no-change disposition.

Measure longest execution turns and causal owner waits before attributing formation delay to synchronous work. Bind foreground/control progress, queue depth/age, acknowledged outcomes, oldest obligations, memory/storage/log growth, cleanup and replay costs to original observations. Select bounded batching/yielding or a worker boundary only from the proven cause, preserving native/SQLite ownership and one decision path.

Pressure may slow or explicitly refuse work but cannot change correctness or drop accepted obligations. Preserve mandatory stabilization retention, two-cycle physical compaction/reclamation, reconstruction and finite-blocker resumption where required. A documented caveat or ever-growing log cannot replace those required proofs. Verify new useful work after blockers clear and after the declared retained-state restart.

declared-envelope-executed binds the frozen profile and actual complete execution; pressure-preserves-obligations-and-progress covers independent outcome accounting and foreground/control liveness; retention-cleanup-and-replay-bounded covers physical resources and existing recovery/retention predicates. independent-verification covers exact profile/candidate applicability, limits and remaining unsupported claims.

Use existing execution and receipt producers; retain original red output and applicable earlier proof. A missing receipt is unavailable/non-measuring, never a fake red or a green. Obtain a genuine measuring baseline before sealing through the current Quest workflow. If current work already satisfies the claim, retain evidence-backed disposition and supported adoption without inventing a new defect or reverting the active candidate. Independent review covers actual production construction, adverse boundary cuts and affected consumers; bind affected execution and applicability to the resulting composed SHA. No hand-authored pass flags or derived summary may substitute for original execution.
